canonical_club_identity: global stable club id independent of competition

classification_rules.PROMOTED: same canonical club has prior-season membership in approved lower division and target-season membership in target top division
classification_rules.RELEGATED: same canonical club has prior-season membership in target top division and target-season membership in approved lower division
classification_rules.RETURNING: same canonical club has earlier top-division membership, one or more intervening seasons outside target top division, and target-season top-division membership
classification_rules.STAYING: same canonical club appears in target top division in both adjacent seasons
classification_rules.UNKNOWN: required exact stable-id membership evidence missing or conflicting
